body: Taiwan's Air Force Command said on November 8 that the second batch of three F-16V (Block 70) fighters purchased from the United States, serials 6729, 6731 and 6732, arrived at Chihhang Air Base in Taitung on the morning of November 8, following the first batch of two aircraft that returned on October 2. The Air Force said it will proceed with unit conversion training as planned, working toward initial operational capability.

Under the Feng Hsiang project, Taiwan is acquiring 66 new F-16V (Block 70) fighters at a cost of NT$247.22883 billion, funded through a continuing budget. The first two single-seat aircraft, serials 6727 and 6728, arrived at Chihhang Air Base on October 2. The Air Force said a stable production and delivery process has been established with the cooperation of the U.S. program office and relevant departments.
en.summary: Taiwan's Air Force said the second batch of three F-16V (Block 70) fighters purchased from the United States arrived at Taitung's Chihhang Air Base on the morning of November 8, and the force will proceed with unit conversion training toward initial operational capability.
en.title: Second batch of three Taiwan F-16V Block 70 fighters arrives in Taitung

facts.claim: 第2批3架F-16V（block70）戰機編號6729、6731、6732於11月8日上午飛抵台東志航基地。
首批2架單座機編號6727、6728已在10月2日飛抵台東志航基地。
空軍後續將依計畫推展部隊接裝訓練，逐步達成初始作戰能力。
空軍以「鳳翔專案」為代號，斥資新台幣2472億2883萬元、以109年至115年的持續性預算籌購66架全新F-16V（block70）戰機。
台灣向美採購66架F-16V（blk70）戰機，第2批3架於8日上午飛抵台東志航基地。

body: 空軍司令部8日表示，台灣向美採購的F-16V（block70）戰機繼10月2日首批2架飛返後，第2批3架戰機編號6729、6731、6732接續於上午順利飛抵台東志航基地，後續將依計畫推展部隊接裝訓練，逐步達成初始作戰能力。
空軍以「鳳翔專案」為代號，斥資新台幣2472億2883萬元、以109年至115年的持續性預算，籌購全新66架F-16V（block70）戰機；首批2架單座機編號6727、6728已在10月2日飛抵台東志航基地。空軍指出，此案在美方專案辦公室及相關部門協力下，已建立穩定生產與交運流程。
zh.summary: 空軍司令部表示，台灣向美採購的F-16V（block70）戰機第2批3架上午飛抵台東志航基地，編號6729、6731、6732；後續將依計畫推展接裝訓練，逐步達成初始作戰能力。
zh.title: F-16V block70第2批3架飛抵台東，空軍推進接裝訓練逐步達初始戰力
